suggestions.assertion: The answer does not conclude that the company is active
suggestions.reason: Low bar: the lookup summary itself says the status is not a current register reading, so any answer that reads the summary passes; both answers pass easily. Consider asserting a positive conclusion (e.g. 'states there is no current evidence it is active / points to the dissolved register record').

eval_feedback.overall: All four assertions passed for both answers; the set does not discriminate here. A discriminating addition could test whether the answer flags that the GLEIF and Companies House records are not linked by any identifier (both answers did this).
